beats: Two kids on one couch, one remote, no way to tell whose turn it was.
Now each player taps in with their own PIN before every move.
A Cloudflare Worker keeps the score table running from one match to the next.
If a kid forgets how winning a small board locks in the big one, one tap opens the rules mid-game.
One remote, one TV, a full nine-board match, no confusion.
